name: AlyawmGold Monthly Gold and Silver Prices
notes: Monthly source averages, copied without recomputing the previously flagged daily series. These are not closing prices.
June-August 2026 were absent from the website monthly tables and recovered directly from Gold API. September 2026 was also retrieved directly to replace the website calculated fallback.
Application-calculated fallback months from captured observations: none.
Only completed UTC months are included. No interpolation or exchange-rate conversion is used.
Reference screening flagged differences above 5% for gold in 1980-12 and 1983-07, and silver in 2025-12. These are review leads, not confirmed errors; source prices are retained.
